topic: Requesting an Early Prescription Refill before Travel

script.title: A REFILL BEFORE TRAVEL
script.scene_zh: 藥局櫃台 · 提早補藥
script.story_hook: Nine pills left, and a three-week trip ahead.
script.intro_zh: 剩下九顆藥，前面是三週的旅程。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to a pharmacy counter before a long trip. Listen for refill talk and travel tips.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到長途旅行前的藥局櫃台。留意補藥的說法，還有旅行的提醒。
script.outro: That's how a refill becomes a travel plan. Listen again and pack your own words.
script.outro_zh: 一次補藥就這樣變成一份旅行計畫。再聽一次，把你的英文也收進行李。
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat after us, line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我們逐句重複。
script.title_quote: I pack my pills first, always
script.char_a_description: a retired man in his mid sixties with thinning white hair neatly combed, wire rim glasses, a navy zip sweater over a checked shirt, and a slim stooped build
script.char_b_description: a quick-smiling woman in her late twenties with a chin-length jet black bob, purple scrubs under a white coat, a lanyard of enamel pins, and a petite build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, I need an early refill, if that's okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ aɪ nid ən ˈɜɹli ɹiˈfɪl ɪf ðæts oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 早安，我想請你幫我提早補藥，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, um, which medicine, and how are you feeling?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ʌm wɪtʃ ˈmɛdəsɪn ænd haʊ ɑɹ ju ˈfilɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好的，嗯，哪一種藥，你最近感覺怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My blood pressure pill, and I feel great, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ blʌd ˈpɹɛʃɚ pɪl ænd aɪ fil ɡɹeɪt θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 我的降血壓藥，我覺得很好，謝謝關心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good to hear, so what's the rush today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə hɪɹ soʊ wæts ðə ɹʌʃ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就好，所以今天為什麼這麼急？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I fly to Taiwan Thursday for three weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ flai tə ˈtaɪˌwɑn ˈθɜɹzdeɪ fɚ θɹi wikz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我週四要飛台灣，在那邊待三週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three weeks, that's a real trip, not a weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi wikz ðæts ə ɹiəl trɪp nɑt ə ˈwikˌɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 三週啊，那是真正的長途旅行，不是週末遊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and I pack my pills first, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd aɪ pæk maɪ pɪlz fɝst ˈɔlˌweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 對，而且我收行李一定先收藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, let me pull your file, one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ lɛt mi pʊl jɔɹ faɪl wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 合理，我把你的資料調出來，稍等我一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, I'm in no real hurry now.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔɹ taɪm aɪm ɪn noʊ ɹiəl ˈhɜɹi naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，我現在其實一點也不著急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's the problem, um, the insurance window isn't open.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ðə ˈpɹɑbləm ʌm ði ɪnˈʃʊɹəns ˈwɪndoʊ ɪzənt ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 問題在這裡，嗯，保險的補藥時間還沒開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The window? Meaning it's too soon, in their words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈminɪŋ ɪts tə suːn ɪn ðɛɹ wɜɹdz/
dialogue.zh: 時間還沒開？也就是說太早了，用他們的說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, you're allowed a refill two days from now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli jʊɹz əˈlaʊd ə ɹiˈfɪl tu deɪz fɹʌm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，你要再等兩天才能補藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two days, but I leave in three, that's tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈdeɪz bʌt aɪ liv ɪn θɹi ðæts taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 兩天，可我三天後就要出發，那很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, let me look at what you have left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈlɛt mi ˈlʊk æt wʌt ju hæv ˈlɛft/
dialogue.zh: 是很緊，我看看你手邊還剩下多少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I counted, nine pills, so a little over a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkaʊnɪtɪd naɪn pɪlz soʊ ə ˈlɪɾəl ˈoʊvɚ ə wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 我算過，剩下九顆，比一週多一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine here, plus three weeks away, that's a gap.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn hɪɹ plʌs θɹi wiːks əˈweɪ ðæts ə ɡæp/
dialogue.zh: 這裡九顆，出門三週，那就會斷藥兩週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the fear, exactly, almost two weeks with none.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə fɪɹ ɪɡˈzæktli ˈɔlmoʊst tu wiːks wɪθ nʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我怕的就是這個，將近兩週沒有任何藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I have three choices for you, ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ hæv θɹi ˈtʃɔɪsəz fɚ ju ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 好，我給你三個選擇，準備聽了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, I'll take all three, um, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz aɪl teɪk ɔl θɹi ʌm ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，三個我都要聽，老實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, a partial fill, I can give you today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ə ˈpaɹʃəl fɪl aɪ kæn ɡɪv ju təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 第一個，部分補藥，我今天就能給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A partial? What does that one mean here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpaɹʃəl wʌt dʊz ðʌt wʌn min hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 部分補藥？那個在這裡是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A week's supply, so seven pills, no waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wiːkz səˈplai soʊ ˈsɛvən pɪlz noʊ ˈweɪɾɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一週的量，就是七顆，不用等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven helps, and choice two, if you don't mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən hɛlpz ænd tʃɔɪs tu ɪf ju doʊnt maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 七顆也有用。那第二個選擇呢，說一下應該不麻煩吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, pay cash for the full bottle right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu peɪ kæʃ fɚ ðə fʊl ˈbɑɾəl ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 第二個，現在就用現金買完整的一瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cash? Um, what does that cost me in dollars?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ ʌm wʌt dʌz ðæt kɔst mi ɪn ˈdɑlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 現金？嗯，那樣要花我多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About eighteen, since the plan won't cover it early.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt eɪˈtin sɪnz ðə plæn woʊnt ˈkʌvɚ ɪt ˈɜɹli/
dialogue.zh: 大約十八塊，因為保險不肯提早給付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighteen, well, that's not a disaster, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪˈtin wɛl ðæts nɑt ə dɪˈzæstɚ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 十八塊，嗯，那不算災難，老實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, and choice three is my favorite, travel trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ænd tʃɔɪs θɹi ɪz maɪ ˈfɛvɹɪt ˈtɹævl trɪk/
dialogue.zh: 不算呀，第三個是我最喜歡的，一個旅行小撇步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A travel trick, okay, I'm listening, tell me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtɹævl trɪk oʊˈkeɪ aɪm ˈlɪsnɪŋ tɛl mi/
dialogue.zh: 旅行小撇步，好，我在聽，你說吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill part here, the rest at our other store, downtown.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪl pɑɹt hɪɹ ðə ɹɛst æt ɑːɹ ˈʌðɚ stɔɹ ˈdaʊnˌtaʊm/
dialogue.zh: 先在這裡拿一部分，剩下的到市中心那間分店拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The downtown one? Does that count as a second visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdaʊnˌtaʊm wʌn dʌz ðæt kaʊnt əz ə ˈsɛkənd ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 市中心那間？那會不會算第二次就診？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the file follows you, just show your ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə faɪl ˈfɑloʊz ju dʒʌst ʃoʊ jɔɹ ˈaɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 不算，你的檔案會跟著你走，只要出示身分證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. And um, swallowing pills is a worry too.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ænd ʌm ˈswɑloʊɪŋ pɪlz ɪz ə ˈwɜɹi tu/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。還有，嗯，吞藥也是我的一個擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hard to swallow on trips, I hear that often.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑɹd tə ˈswɑloʊ ɑn trɪps aɪ hɪɹ ðæt ˈɔfən/
dialogue.zh: 在旅途中很難吞藥，我常聽到這種事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! On planes, dry mouth, everything sticks, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɑn pleɪnz draɪ maʊθ ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ stɪks ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 對！在飛機上嘴巴很乾，什麼都會卡住，你懂的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a liquid version of that same pill, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ə ˈlɪkwɪd ˈvɜɹʒən əv ðæt seɪm pɪl ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 其實同一種藥，有液體的版本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Liquid? Wow, does it work the same as these?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪkwɪd waʊ dʌz ɪt wɝk ðə seɪm æz ðiz/
dialogue.zh: 液體的？哇，效果跟這些一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same dose, it just tastes a bit like chalk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈseɪm ˈdoʊs ɪt dʒʌst ˈteɪsts ə bɪt laɪk ˈtʃɔk/
dialogue.zh: 一樣的劑量，只是味道有一點像粉筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chalk is fine, chalk doesn't get stuck in my throat.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɔk ɪz faɪn tʃɔk ˈdʌzənt ɡɛt stʌk ɪn maɪ θɹoʊt/
dialogue.zh: 像粉筆沒關係，粉筆不會卡在我的喉嚨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, true. I'll ask the doctor to approve it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tru aɪl æsk ðə ˈdɑkɾɚ tə əˈpɹuv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，說得對。我會請醫生同意換成液體的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that take long, since I leave Thursday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðæt teɪk lɔŋ sɪnz aɪ liv ˈθɜɹzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那會很久嗎，畢竟我週四就要出發？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he answers fast, um, usually same day.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hi ˈænsɚz fæst ʌm ˈjuʒəwəli seɪm deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不會，他回覆很快，嗯，通常當天就回。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then yes, please, the liquid sounds perfect to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɛs pliz ðə ˈlɪkwɪd ˈsaʊndz ˈpɝfɪkt tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 那就太好了，液體那個對我來說很完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Also, want a travel letter for your bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ˈɔlsoʊ wɑnt ə ˈtɹævl ˈlɛɾɚ fɚ jɔɹ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 幫你辦。另外，你要不要一張旅行的說明信？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A letter saying the pills are mine? That's useful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɛɾɚ ˈseɪɪŋ ðə pɪlz ɑɹ maɪn ðæts ˈjusfəl/
dialogue.zh: 說明那些藥是我自己的信？那真的有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says your name, dose, and why you carry them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz jɔɹ neɪm doʊs ænd waɪ ju ˈkæɹi ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫你的名字、劑量，還有為什麼要帶著它們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Security people ask that, I got stopped last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /səˈkjʊɹəɾi ˈpipəl æsk ðæt aɪ ɡɑt stɑpt læst jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 安檢人員會問這個，我去年在安檢站也遇過一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They do, one printed page saves twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ du wʌn ˈpɹɪnɪd peɪdʒ ˈseɪvz ˈtwɛnɪ ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 他們會問的，一張印好的紙就能省二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Print it, um, and do they stay in my carry-on?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɹɪnt ɪt ʌm ænd du ðeɪ steɪ ɪn maɪ ˈkæɹiˌɑn/
dialogue.zh: 請印給我，嗯，那藥要放在我的手提行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always in the carry-on, never the checked bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz ɪn ðə ˈkæɹiˌɑn ˈnɛvɚ ðə ˈtʃɛkt bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 一定要放手提行李，千萬不要放託運的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good rule, my friend lost a suitcase once, with meds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ɹul maɪ fɹɛnd lɑst ə ˈsuːtˌkeɪs wʌns wɪð mɛdz/
dialogue.zh: 好的原則，我朋友有一次行李整個遺失，裡面全是藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, that's why I say it every trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæts waɪ aɪ seɪ ɪt ˈɛvɹi trɪp/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，所以我每次旅行都要提醒這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, seven today, the rest downtown, plus the liquid?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈsɛvən təˈdeɪ ðə ɹɛst ˈdaʊnˌtaʊm plʌz ðə ˈlɪkwɪd/
dialogue.zh: 所以，今天七顆，剩下的去市中心那間，還有液體的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, and I'll label each bottle, so no confusion.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ænd aɪl ˈleɪbəl itʃ ˈbɑɾəl soʊ noʊ kənˈfjuʒən/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，我會每個瓶子都貼標籤，就不會搞混。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've thought of everything, that's very kind, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /juv θɔt əv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ðæts ˈvɛɹi kaɪnd θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 你想得太周到了，真的很體貼，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's my job, but I like the puzzle part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts maɪ dʒɑb bʌt aɪ laɪk ðə ˈpʌzəl pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的工作，但我喜歡那種拼圖的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A puzzle with pills, ha, that's the best kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpʌzəl wɪθ pɪlz hɑ ðæts ðə bɛst kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 用藥拼圖，哈，那是最好的一種拼圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, your bag, and pay at that corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ju ɡoʊ jɔɹ bæɡ ænd peɪ æt ðæt ˈkɔɹnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 給你，你的袋子，然後在角落那邊付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday, Taiwan, and three weeks of medicine, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜɹzdeɪ ˈtaɪˌwɑn ænd θɹi wiːkz əv ˈmɛdəsɪn dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 週四、台灣、三週的藥都齊了，完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe flight, and come back with a story, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪk flait ænd kʌm bæk wɪð ə ˈstɔɹi pliz/
dialogue.zh: 一路順飛，回來記得跟我說一個旅途故事。

script.youtube_title: 【出國前藥不夠吃💊】「我收行李一定先收藥」教你請藥局提早補藥🧳🎧｜聽完會問三個選擇｜60句沉浸式英文聽力｜Early Prescription Refill
script.youtube_title_en: "I Pack My Pills First, Always" — An Early Prescription Refill Before a Trip
script.youtube_description:
要出國三週，藥卻只剩九顆，保險又不肯提早給付，這種事在藥局要怎麼開口？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英文聽力練習，場景就在藥局的領藥櫃台，從請求提早補藥、查出還剩幾天，一路聽到三個解決辦法與旅行的準備。

你會聽到：怎麼說出 I need an early refill；怎麼聽懂保險窗口還沒開、你還要再等兩天；三個選項的完整說法，部分補藥、用現金買整瓶、到另一間分店領剩下的；還有吞藥困難換液體版本、開一張旅行說明信、藥要放手提行李的實用提醒。

整段只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現的是美國人在藥局與機場都這樣說話的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、honestly。聽完你就會用：Let me pull your file、A week's supply、Pay cash、Show your ID、Safe flight。
